name: Moms
overview: Scripture honors the role of mothers as a divine blessing, describing children as a heritage and reward from the LORD. Mothers are called to nurture and guide their children in the ways of the Lord, ensuring their lasting faith and character. The Proverbs 31 woman exemplifies strength and honor, rejoicing in the future, while Isaiah reflects the comforting nature of a mother as a picture of God's own comfort toward His people. This underscores the vital spiritual and nurturing role mothers, including stay-at-home moms, fulfill in the family and community.
